description: This file provides an interface to trigger the WhisperX model for subtitle processing, specifically exposing the 'run_whisperx_on_file' function which simulates integration with the WhisperX model for generating subtitles.

methods.name: List[dict] run_whisperx_on_file(input_path: str)
methods.description: Simulates calling the WhisperX model on an input file to generate subtitle data as a list of dictionaries containing start, end, and text fields.
